data.one_liner: Core framework for Relic web server
data.what_it_does: Provides a platform-agnostic core framework for building high-performance web servers and services in Dart. Offers a trie-based router, typed request and header handling, and WebSocket support.
use_when: You want to build a modern HTTP server or web API in Dart
You are looking for an alternative to Shelf with built-in routing and typed headers
avoid_when: You are building a client-side Flutter application that only makes outgoing HTTP requests
strengths: Strongly typed APIs and validated HTTP headers
Built-in trie-based router and WebSocket support
weaknesses: Requires a separate adapter like relic_io or relic_native to actually serve requests
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart 3.7 or newer (Relic 2.0.0 requires Dart 3.10.0+).
